about: All user-facing text of the app, one entry per language. status: 'verified' (checked by a native speaker) or 'machine_draft' (drafted by an AI assistant, not checked). draft_confidence is the drafter's own estimate and is only a hint for reviewers. {pct} is replaced by the severity number. Review sheet: python -m src.mobile.review_sheet
